Use case: identity-preserve. Edit IMAGE1 as one single production sprite, preserving its canvas and character size. IMAGE1 is the ONLY identity/composition/upper-body reference. IMAGE2 bamboo girl is shoe-axis/perspective reference only, do not copy her character, limbs, props or phase. IMAGE3 is approved painted style.

Show real ankle/heel/toe support behind the body. For second variant show subtly more knee loading/extension than the first while maintaining the same spatial contact zone; independently drawn actual posture.

Same short white bob, furry ears, left hair ornament, white-lilac short fur robe, rear purple bow; no girl tail, no back fox-face belt buckle. Ground plane is invisible: no floor, shadow, background or guide marks. All boots inside the existing full square canvas with margin. Transparent RGBA, sharp detailed painted sprite, no text, no motion trails, no copies.
